mapping_json.fidelity_notes: PROXY-MENAGERIE build -- PROXY_ASCENSION (the summoner minion archetype) + PROXY_CONVERGENCE (multiple proxy TYPES converging into one build where the menagerie's combined effect drives output; the support-golems buff the damage-golems). fire family (Flame Golems are the damage), burn as the ignite rider (probe control=burn). Geometry totem for each golem (autonomous placed proxy). THE IDENTITY = 'Primordial jewels turn a menagerie of golem types into the whole build' -- Harmony jewels reset flame-golem cooldowns (the DPS driver -> minion-cast-speed/cooldown trait) and Eminence jewels grant Golem Effectiveness across the squad (the network-buff -> golem-effectiveness affix).
